decision_rule: Packet 02 requires every important current reasoning path to be known. Operational systems that are optional, user-mediated, unconnected to normal Resident reasoning, or outside the installed source runtime are classified as limits rather than unresolved reasoning-path watches.

closures.prior_watch: Backend implementation and retention/security were unverified.
basis: No provider, model, AI authentication, AI request formatter, or AI response parser was found in the corrected current Resident route.
Known client backend paths are optional test/archive/private-memory sync paths.
Normal residentRun does not require the backend and remains local when it is absent or unavailable.
closures.remaining_limit: A future backend must be designed in Packet 06 and implemented only in an authorized implementation packet.

closures.prior_watch: Live installed iPhone Home Screen runtime was not observed.
basis: Packet 02 identifies the repository-defined current route, reasoning source, authority ceiling, privacy boundary, and failure behavior.
Installed-device cache identity is an operational deployment check, not an unknown reasoning source.
No audit conclusion depends on claiming that a particular installed cache was executed.
closures.remaining_limit: Do not claim the user's installed iPhone cache/runtime was tested.

closures.prior_watch: Exact runtime ordering among injected residentRun wrappers was not live-observed.
basis: The active wrapper set is bounded to X-Ray, Lossless Readiness, Copy Lossless Diagnostic, and original v6 residentRun.
X-Ray adds safe context then delegates.
Readiness and diagnostic wrappers consume only their narrow matching requests and otherwise delegate.
No possible ordering among these bounded wrappers introduces an AI model call, hidden authority, repository write, promotion, rollback, or validator control.
Therefore exact outermost ordering is not an important unknown current reasoning path for Packet 02.
closures.remaining_limit: Do not claim a live wrapper order was observed.

closures.prior_watch: Shortcut completion depends on the user's iPhone Shortcut setup.
basis: Shortcut paths require explicit copy/open/user action.
They do not generate Resident reasoning.
They do not prove direct Resident repository or Notes authority.
Failure leaves the packet copied or the external action incomplete without changing the reasoning result.
closures.remaining_limit: Do not claim Shortcut execution or external save completion was tested.

important_current_reasoning_paths.normal_resident: Corrected current route -> base v6 Resident drawer -> bounded wrappers -> local regex/decision/templates/reports or manual ChatGPT handoff -> reply/work/warning and local records.
important_current_reasoning_paths.deep_resident: resident.html local classification/templates/reports; no model call or change authority.
important_current_reasoning_paths.bug_memory_resident: bm.html local/manual private-memory support; no model call or autonomous authority.
important_current_reasoning_paths.safe_writer_and_code_safety: Local context/report/handoff wrappers; no autonomous model, repository, promotion, rollback, or validator authority.
important_current_reasoning_paths.external_handoffs: Clipboard, Shortcut, and optional backend paths are explicit tool/transfer paths, not current reasoning engines.

operational_limits_not_watches: Deployed public runtime not executed in this audit.
Optional backend server implementation not available or verified.
Exact live outermost wrapper order not observed.
safe_claim: No important current Resident reasoning path remains unknown for Packet 02. The current reasoning source and authority boundary are fully classified: local deterministic rules/templates/context reports plus manual ChatGPT handoff, with optional user-mediated transfer tools and no verified direct AI model or autonomous change authority.
do_not_claim: Backend or Shortcut execution was tested.
A live wrapper order was observed.
Resident has an external AI reasoning engine.
Resident can write, commit, promote, roll back, or alter validators autonomously.
